The *Sappaṭighaduka* ("Dyad on Impingement") is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Pali Canon. The text analyzes conditional relations (*paccaya*) applied to phenomena with sensory impingement or reactivity (*sappaṭigha*) and those without (*appaṭigha*).
